currentAds.headline: R1T — Every road is an invitation
POV: Your office has no walls

campaignDescription: Launch campaign for the 2026 Rivian R1T Adventure Package. Targeting outdoor enthusiasts and adventure-seeking millennials aged 28-42. Highlight the new extended range battery (400+ miles), integrated camp kitchen, and gear tunnel. Key markets: Colorado, Pacific Northwest, Northern California. Summer timing — emphasize road trips and outdoor adventure. Platforms: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook. Budget: $50K media spend over 4 weeks.
